name: tractor_front
source: Plausible Magic Formula coefficients for a radial agricultural front tyre (e.g. 480/65R24 class), following Pacejka 'Tyre and Vehicle Dynamics' 3rd ed. ch. 4's MF5.2 structure. Peak friction on a firm/paved surface (Dx1/Dy1 ~= 0.85) and higher rolling resistance/lower stiffness than a passenger radial reflect the general agricultural-tyre trends reported in Wong, 'Theory of Ground Vehicles', 5th ed., ch. 1 (Table 1.3) and ch. 2 - not a measured/proprietary .tir. unloaded_radius=0.8 m matches data/models/tractor/tractor.rig.json's front wheel radius.
